maudhui: (1) Every person has the right to the freedom of conscience, faith and choice in matters of religion, including the freedom to change his religion or faith. (2) Protection of rights referred to in this Article shall be in accordance with the provisions prescribed by the laws which are of importance to a democratic society for security, peace, morality, unity of the society and national cohesion. (3) In this Article reference to the word "religion" shall be construed as including reference to religious denominations, and cognate expressions shall be construed accordingly. (4) Every religious denomination shall be free to manage its affairs without interference in activities of its organization, institutions and religious teaching; and the state authority shall not interfere in the internal affairs of any religious denomination. (5) The United Republic is a secular state and therefore there shall be no state religion.
